Find the polar equation of the ray shown above. Assume that the polar angle is in the range $[0,2\pi ).$

The polar equation is $\theta =$
{{field-1}}.
feedback.worked_solution:
The counterclockwise angle that the ray makes with the positive $x$-axis is

$$
\pi -\frac{\pi }{5}=\frac{4\pi }{5}.
$$

Therefore, the polar equation of the ray is $\theta =\frac{4\pi }{5}.$
